cases.customer_question: What is the difference in qualification effort between using a pre-qualified module and designing a module from a BLE chip?
cases.actual_issue: Understanding how design approach impacts required testing scope, especially RF PHY testing.
cases.consultant_answer: When using a pre-qualified module, RF PHY testing can be omitted because it has already been validated. However, when designing a module from a BLE chip (SoC), RF PHY testing must be performed at the product level. Additionally, any implemented SIG-defined profiles require PTS testing.
cases.final_recommendation: If designing from a BLE chip, plan for full RF PHY testing and profile PTS testing; if using a pre-qualified module, leverage existing qualification to reduce testing scope.
